pick.headline: Anwar Sadat assassinated in Cairo
pick.summary: On 6 October 1981 Egyptian President Anwar Sadat was shot dead by soldiers of an Islamist cell while reviewing a military parade in Cairo.
pick.significance: Sadat had made peace with Israel at Camp David and aligned Egypt with the United States. His killing exposed an Islamist underground within the army, and Hosni Mubarak succeeded him.
